name: just-simple-excalidraw
description: A fully local Excalidraw editor for Obsidian.
author: David Hurtado

scripts.test: node scripts/test-file-isolation.mjs && node scripts/test-excalidraw-environment.mjs && npm run test:preview && npm run test:naming && npm run test:snap && npm run test:capabilities && npm run test:overlap && npm run test:panels
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && node esbuild.config.mjs production && node scripts/generate-third-party-notices.mjs && node scripts/copy-assets.mjs
scripts.check: npm test && npm run build && npm run audit:release
